route.rationale: one function, no shape change; concept typo rides along

cells.title: Write git stdin from a thread so a long patch-id stream cannot deadlock
cells.action: Per run-git-stdin-thread D1: in run_git_stdin, take the child's stdin, move the input into std::thread::spawn which does write_all and drops the handle, call child.wait_with_output on the parent, then join the thread and ignore its result. Keep GitOut and every fail-open path. Per D2 no new test. Fix the typo 'A cleaner rebase' to 'A clean rebase' in the concept. No code comments.
cells.verify: `PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee verbs::worktree::tests` is green; `rg -c 'A clean rebase is not stale proof' docs/knowledge/areas/worktree-parallelism/returning-and-the-merge-gate.md` prints 1; `.bee/bin/bee dev comment-baseline --check` is clean.

truths: run_git_stdin never blocks on a full stdout pipe
every existing worktree test stays green

artifacts.substantive: stdin written from a spawned thread, stdout read with wait_with_output

prohibitions: No change to the GitOut shape
